narration: Your credit score doesn't just affect loans. In 47 states, it secretly controls your car insurance rate — and the gap is absolutely massive.
visual: Credit score gauge (semi-circular meter) with five color zones from red to green. Animated needle springs from the far left to the orange-yellow zone at score 520. '47 STATES' badge below. '$999/YEAR GAP' text fades in.

narration: A driver with poor credit pays $1,867 a year for car insurance. Same driver, great credit? Just $868. That thousand-dollar gap is completely invisible to you.
visual: Simple car SVG (body, roof, two wheels, windshield) centered on light background. Two animated price bars grow up below it — tall red bar labeled POOR CREDIT ($1,867) and short green bar labeled GREAT CREDIT ($868). '$999 ANNUAL GAP' badge at bottom.

narration: Over ten years that gap quietly stacks to nearly $10,000. Your insurer isn't going to tell you they're doing this — and most people have absolutely no idea.
visual: Dark background. Ten bars grow in with stagger, each taller than the last. Large dollar counter at top animates from $0 to $9,990. Year labels (Y1-Y10) below each bar. Bridge text: 'YOUR INSURER WON'T TELL YOU THIS. BUT YOU CAN FIX IT IN 30 DAYS.'

narration: It's called a credit-based insurance score, legal in 47 states. And 42% of drivers never knew it existed. Your insurer is quietly counting on that ignorance.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette with question mark bubble springs in. Large '42%' statistic animates up. Subtitle: 'HAD NO IDEA / IT AFFECTED THEIR INSURANCE'. Blue badge: '47 STATES — IT'S ALL LEGAL'.

narration: Here's the fix — get your credit card balance under 10% utilization. That alone can move you a full tier in just 30 days, and your next renewal will reflect it.
visual: Dark background. Credit card SVG (blue card, chip, masked card number). Below it, a utilization bar animates from 80% (red) down to 10% (green). Percentage label updates in real time. '80% = HIGH RISK' → '10% = SWEET SPOT' transition.

narration: The average savings for moving one credit tier is $503 a year. Check your utilization tonight — your insurance renewal is waiting on whether you know this.
visual: Light background. Piggy bank SVG (yellow/amber body, head, snout, four legs, curly tail). Coin drops into coin slot. Dollar counter animates from $0 to $503. Black CTA bar: 'CHECK YOUR UTILIZATION TONIGHT'. Final text: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY MOVES.'
